canonical_statement: The investigators used a retrospective new-user, active-comparator comparative-effectiveness cohort design in Medicare fee-for-service claims.

canonical_statement: Confounding control used 1:1 nearest-neighbor propensity-score matching without replacement with a 0.01 caliper, based on 143 baseline covariates; propensity scores were re-estimated within prespecified subgroups.
Treatment effects were estimated as hazard ratios using a Fine-Gray Cox regression model and as absolute rate differences using weighted least squares; subgroup heterogeneity used Wald tests.

canonical_statement: Bias analyses suggested the primary estimates were fairly robust even under strong hypothetical residual confounding by HbA1c.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: fully adjusted effect estimates were fairly robust even under extreme scenarios

canonical_statement: Secondary subgroup analyses using the full GLP-1RA and DPP-4 inhibitor classes were broadly consistent with the main agent-specific findings, although the modified MACE estimates for empagliflozin vs GLP-1RAs were closer to the null in ASCVD and heart-failure subgroups.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: results were consistent with main findings, both overall and across subgroups

canonical_statement: Outcomes were identified from Medicare claims rather than clinical adjudication, although the authors cited prior validation of the algorithms.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Our outcome definitions were based on Medicare claims-based data

canonical_statement: Cardiovascular-specific mortality could not be evaluated; all-cause mortality was used in the modified MACE composite.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We also could not evaluate cardiovascular-specific mortality

canonical_statement: Median treatment duration was only about 5 to 6 months, limiting inference about longer-term comparative effectiveness.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: brief median treatment duration in the cohorts, which was approximately 5 to 6 months

canonical_statement: Because treatment assignment was not randomized, residual confounding could not be eliminated.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Due to the lack of randomization, the possibility of residual confounding cannot be entirely eliminated

canonical_statement: The authors concluded that empagliflozin was associated with lower HHF risk than liraglutide or sitagliptin and lower modified MACE risk than sitagliptin, with larger absolute benefits in patients with established cardiorenal disease.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: empagliflozin was associated with a lower risk of both modified MACE and HHF outcomes

canonical_statement: The study reported funding from Boehringer Ingelheim plus NIH/NIA, ADA, PCORI, and FDA grants.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: This study was supported by grant 116283 ... from Boehringer Ingelheim

canonical_statement: The authors stated that funding organizations had no role in study design, conduct, data handling, interpretation, manuscript preparation, or publication decisions.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The funding organizations had no role in the design and conduct of the study
